trust_decision.summary: An ancestor page's user-supplied MenuTitle (falling back to Title) is concatenated into an HTML string in the CMS page list view and that string is cast to HTMLFragment, so the title crosses the untrusted-content-to-HTML boundary unescaped: it must be XML-escaped before it is placed in the fragment.

landing_point.why: The advisory summary says 'XSS in breadcrumbs in page list view'; the only list-view breadcrumb code is this inline ancestor loop inside the getTreeTitle column formatter of CMSMain::ListViewForm().

fix_sites.entry_point: CMSMain::ListViewForm() getTreeTitle column formatter; rendered by the 'listview' action (GET /admin/pages/listview, see LinkListView at code/Controllers/CMSMain.php:305), by GET /admin/pages?ParentID=N when the tree is filtered (templates/SilverStripe/CMS/Controllers/Includes/CMSMain_RecordList.ss:9-10), and by the X-Pjax 'ListViewForm' fragment callback (code/Controllers/CMSMain.php:211-213)
fix_sites.module_kind: CMS admin controller - GridFieldDataColumns HTML field formatter

fix_sites.entry_point: new private CMSMain::getListViewBreadcrumbs() helper, called only from the getTreeTitle formatter above
fix_sites.module_kind: private helper in the same controller file

O3_reason_to_dismiss: No O2 site and no O8 route exist; the nearest dismissible surface is the CMS crumb bar (CMSMain::buildListViewBreadcrumb, code/Controllers/CMSMain.php:1011-1033), which a solver could wave away as out of scope because it hands plain values to a template rather than building HTML.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: The same formatter emits an <a class="action-detail"> link plus getRecordTreeMarkup() HTML (which already escapes the item's own title, with an xml2raw/raw2xml idempotency guard), and the column is deliberately cast to HTMLFragment. A fix that escapes the whole formatter output, drops the HTMLFragment cast, or escapes the item title again escapes the intended markup or double-encodes titles ('&amp;'), visibly breaking the clickable list-view rows and their tree-icon/status badges.

O6_input_shapes: ancestor with empty MenuTitle, falling back to Title
special characters in the title: & < > " (the fix's own data provider covers &amp, <script>, double quote)

no ancestors at all (empty

must still be produced)

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A second HTML-cast list/grid column added by an extension that repeats the same ancestor-title concatenation.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The list view is explicitly extensible via $this->extend('updateListView', $listview); adding a column and reusing the breadcrumb snippet is the obvious way a module author would copy this code.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: The CMS crumb bar builds the same MenuTitle ?: Title ancestor list; a variant that concatenates those titles into an HTML string instead of pushing template values would repeat the bug.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Same file, same ancestor-list idiom and same author intent as the fixed block, so a maintainer could plausibly have written the inline-HTML version here - and it is exactly the neighbouring feature a solver would call out of scope.

O9_family: xss (CWE-79), stored in CMS admin UI

O10_build.toolchain: PHP ^8.3 + Composer (silverstripe-vendormodule); no vendor/ and no composer.lock in the pinned tree, so composer install needs network at build time; PHPUnit ^11.3 (phpunit.xml.dist)
services: database server (MySQL/MariaDB or Postgres) - CMSMainTest is a FunctionalTest and the sqlite3 module is not required
O10_build.project_tests: tests/php/Controllers/CMSMainTest.php: functional testBreadcrumbs / testBreadcrumbsListView / testBreadcrumbsListViewWithPjax / testBreadcrumbsSearchView and unit testGetRecordTreeMarkup (tests/php/Controllers/CMSMainTest.php:415-513, 937-945). None of them assert the list-view item breadcrumb HTML at the pinned commit, which is why the fix adds reflection-based unit tests.

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix:
Wrap the breadcrumb string, or the whole sprintf() output / column value, in Convert::raw2xml() - which escapes the intended

markup and double-escapes the item title that getRecordTreeMarkup already escaped.

out_of_scope_notes: tests/php/Controllers/CMSMainTest.php:42 carries a stray 'use function Embed\html;' import at the pinned commit (unused, the fix deletes it); it is unrelated to this advisory and not pursued.
unverified: repo_mb was not measured (no shell in this session; composer.lock/vendor absent), so the tiny_repo threshold was not asserted either way - code/ holds 46 PHP files and the checkout also carries client/dist build artifacts and many lang files.

SilverStripe\Admin\CMSBreadcrumbs template (silverstripe-admin is a sibling module, not vendored here) could not be read, so whether the crumb bar at code/Controllers/CMSMain.php:1002/1029 escapes $Title by default is unknown; it was therefore not raised as an O8 route.
Framework code (Hierarchy::getAncestors(), getTreeTitle(), Convert::raw2xml()) is not vendored; its behaviour is taken from the call sites in this tree.
Whether GET /admin/pages/ListViewForm is routable as a form endpoint in framework 6 was assumed from SilverStripe form-routing convention, not read in framework source.

The list view is reachable through several URLs (listview action, ?ParentID= index render, X-Pjax ListViewForm fragment, form endpoint) but all funnel through the single CMSMain::ListViewForm() handler, so O1 was counted as 1 site/entry point.
